comparison: Directly proves Pillar 3 (exchangeability-invariant pooled-tangent conditional fiber residualization) is causally necessary for conditional mean/covariance fidelity while orthogonal to unconditional transport.
conclusion: Knocking out Pillar 3 (rgdt_fiber_residual_weight=0.0) selectively degrades conditional fiber tasks—model_ddgan_gaussian_chain final_normalized_mean degrades 0.2311 (PASS) -> 0.2813 (FAIL), final_projection_cdf degrades 0.1048 (PASS) -> 0.1849 (FAIL), and final_covariance_eigen_min collapses 0.9087 (PASS) -> 0.2913 < 0.65 (FAIL), while model_ae_ddgan_gaussian_chain t1_q0_covariance_eigen_max jumps 1.8675 -> 2.4385—while leaving unconditional t3_iso_scale_mass_8x and t3_iso_horizon_saddle_shift bit-for-bit PASS.
